_comment: Grow's Aqidah world: al-Aqida al-Tahawiyya, part by part, lesson by lesson. Hand-written. The book has no headings, only numbered statements (0, the opening, to 105): each part takes a run of them (`statements` [from, to]); its `kitab` is a short Arabic label for the header. Every `ar` and `source` is the book's own words, from backend/data/books/openiti/<file>; src/lib/bookLesson.test.js checks each, and that a `whole` part touches every one of its statements. `en` and `why` are our English. We teach what al-Tahawi says, in plain words; where later schools read a line differently, a neutral Note says so, and nothing is asked on it.
_cards: teach {title, ar, en} · choose {ask, ar?, options, answer: index, arabic-options?, source, why} — an `ar` with ____ is a gap the answer fills · pick {ask, options: [{text, right?}], source, why} · sort {ask, into, items: [[text, bucket]], source, why} · order {ask, steps (in the right order), source, why}. `source` may be one quote or a list.
author: Abu Ja'far al-Tahawi (d. 321 AH)
madhhab: Ahl al-Sunna, on the way of Abu Hanifa and his two companions

lessons.title: The creed, and Allah is One

cards.title: Whose creed this is
cards.ar: هذا ذكر بيان عقيدة أهل السنة والجماعة على مذهب فقهاء الملة أبي حنيفة النعمان بن ثابت الكوفي وأبي يوسف يعقوب بن إبراهيم الأنصاري وأبي عبدالله محمد بن الحسن الشيباني
cards.en: Al-Tahawi opens: this sets out the creed of Ahl al-Sunna wal-Jama'a on the way of the jurists Abu Hanifa, Abu Yusuf and Muhammad ibn al-Hasan: what they believe of the roots of the religion.

cards.ask: What does al-Tahawi say his book sets out?
options: The creed of Ahl al-Sunna wal-Jama'a
The rulings of purity, prayer and fasting
cards.source: هذا ذكر بيان عقيدة أهل السنة والجماعة
cards.why: He calls it a statement of the creed ('aqida) of Ahl al-Sunna wal-Jama'a, and what they believe of the roots of the religion.

cards.ask: Which jurists does al-Tahawi name in his opening?
cards.source: على مذهب فقهاء الملة أبي حنيفة النعمان بن ثابت الكوفي وأبي يوسف يعقوب بن إبراهيم الأنصاري وأبي عبدالله محمد بن الحسن الشيباني
cards.why: He sets out the creed on the way of three jurists: Abu Hanifa and his two companions, Abu Yusuf and Muhammad ibn al-Hasan.

cards.title: Allah is One
cards.ar: نقول في توحيد الله معتقدين بتوفيق الله إن الله واحد لا شريك له
cards.en: His first words on tawhid (Allah's oneness): "We say, believing it by Allah's help: Allah is One, with no partner."

cards.title: Three denials
cards.ar: ولا شي مثله ولا شيء يعجزه ولا إله غيره
cards.en: Then three denials: nothing is like Him, nothing is beyond His power, and there is no god but Him.

cards.ask: Which word completes al-Tahawi's statement?
cards.ar: ولا شيء ____
cards.source: ولا شيء يعجزه
cards.why: يعجزه: nothing is beyond His power, nothing can defeat Him.

cards.ask: Which of these does al-Tahawi affirm?

options.text: There is no god but Him
He has a partner in creating
Some things are beyond His power

source: إن الله واحد لا شريك له
ولا شي مثله ولا شيء يعجزه ولا إله غيره
cards.why: He affirms that Allah is One, with no partner, none like Him and no god but Him; and nothing is beyond His power.

cards.ask: What does لا شريك له (la sharika lahu) say of Allah?
options: He has no helper in war
He has no beginning at all
cards.source: إن الله واحد لا شريك له
cards.why: Sharik is a partner: Allah is One, with no partner.

cards.ask: Sort: what al-Tahawi affirms of Allah, and what he denies.
source: إن الله واحد لا شريك له
ولا شي مثله ولا شيء يعجزه ولا إله غيره
cards.why: He affirms His oneness and that there is no god but Him, and denies any partner, anything like Him, and anything beyond His power.

cards.ask: Which is true, as al-Tahawi says it?
options: Some things are too hard even for Allah
Allah is one god among others
cards.source: ولا شيء يعجزه ولا إله غيره
cards.why: Nothing is beyond His power, and there is no god but Him.

cards.title: Without beginning, without end
cards.ar: قديم بلا ابتداء دائم بلا انتهاء
cards.en: He is Eternal (qadim) without beginning, and Everlasting (da'im) without end.

cards.ask: Which does al-Tahawi say of Allah?

options.text: He will end when the world ends

cards.source: قديم بلا ابتداء دائم بلا انتهاء
cards.why: Qadim without beginning, da'im without end: He has neither.

cards.title: Only what He wills
cards.ar: لا يفنى ولا يبيد ولا يكون إلا ما يريد
cards.en: He does not perish or pass away. And nothing comes to be except what He wills.

cards.ask: Which word completes al-Tahawi's statement?
cards.ar: ولا يكون إلا ما ____
cards.source: ولا يكون إلا ما يريد
cards.why: يريد: nothing comes to be except what He wills.

cards.ask: Which is true, as al-Tahawi says it?
options: Nothing comes to be except what Allah wills
Most things come to be without Allah's will
Allah's will covers the heavens only
cards.source: ولا يكون إلا ما يريد
cards.why: Nothing at all comes to be except what He wills.

cards.title: Beyond imagining
cards.ar: لا تبلغه الأوهام ولا تدركه الأفهام ولا يشبه الأنام
cards.en: Imaginations do not reach Him, minds do not grasp Him, and He does not resemble created beings (al-anam).

cards.title: Living, Self-Sustaining
cards.ar: حي لا يموت قيوم لا ينام
cards.en: He is Living (hayy) and does not die; Self-Sustaining (qayyum) and does not sleep.

cards.ask: Al-Tahawi says Allah is Qayyum (Self-Sustaining) and...
options: He does not hear at all
cards.source: قيوم لا ينام
cards.why: Qayyum la yanam: Self-Sustaining, and He does not sleep.

cards.ask: Which does al-Tahawi deny of Allah?

options.text: That He wills what comes to be

source: لا تبلغه الأوهام ولا تدركه الأفهام ولا يشبه الأنام
حي لا يموت قيوم لا ينام
cards.why: He is Living and wills all that comes to be; He does not die or sleep, resemble creatures, or come within minds' grasp.

cards.ask: What does al-Tahawi say does not reach Allah?
options: The du'a of those who call on Him
cards.source: لا تبلغه الأوهام
cards.why: La tablughuhu al-awham: imaginations do not reach Him.

cards.title: Creator, Provider
cards.ar: خالق بلا حاجة رازق بلا مؤنة
cards.en: He creates, not out of any need; He provides, with no burden on Him.

cards.title: Giving death, raising
cards.ar: مميت بلا مخافة باعث بلا مشقة
cards.en: He causes death, without fear of anyone; He raises the dead, without hardship.

cards.ask: Al-Tahawi says Allah provides...
options: Only to those who ask Him
cards.source: رازق بلا مؤنة
cards.why: Raziq bila mu'na: He provides, and it is no burden on Him.

cards.ask: Which word completes al-Tahawi's statement?
cards.ar: خالق بلا ____
cards.source: خالق بلا حاجة
cards.why: حاجة: He creates without any need of what He creates.

cards.ask: Al-Tahawi says Allah raises the dead...
cards.source: باعث بلا مشقة
cards.why: Ba'ith bila mashaqqa: He raises the dead with no hardship.

cards.title: His attributes before creation
cards.ar: ما زال بصفاته قديما قبل خلقه لم يزدد بكونهم شيئا لم يكن قبلهم من صفته
cards.en: He has always had His attributes, eternally, before He created. Creation coming into being added nothing to His attributes that He did not have before it.

cards.ask: Which is true, as al-Tahawi says it?
options: Allah had His attributes before He created anything
Allah gained new attributes once creation came to exist
Allah's attributes began with the first creation
cards.source: ما زال بصفاته قديما قبل خلقه
cards.why: He has always been with His attributes, before His creation; creation added nothing to them.

cards.title: And forever after
cards.ar: وكما كان بصفاته أزليا كذلك لا يزال عليها أبديا
cards.en: As He was with His attributes without beginning (azali), so He remains with them without end (abadi).

cards.title: Not a name gained by creating
cards.ar: ليس بعد خلق الخلق استفاد اسم الخالق ولا بإحداث البرية استفاد اسم الباري
cards.en: He did not gain the name al-Khaliq (the Creator) only after creating, nor the name al-Bari (the Maker) only after bringing creatures about.

cards.ask: Did Allah gain the name al-Khaliq (the Creator) after He created?
options: No: He did not gain it after creating
Yes: when He created the first thing
Yes: when people first called Him by it
cards.source: ليس بعد خلق الخلق استفاد اسم الخالق
cards.why: He did not gain the name Creator after creating; it is His without beginning.

cards.ask: Which of these does al-Tahawi affirm?

options.text: Creation added nothing to His attributes
He became the Creator only after creating
His attributes grew as creation grew

source: لم يزدد بكونهم شيئا لم يكن قبلهم من صفته
وكما كان بصفاته أزليا كذلك لا يزال عليها أبديا
cards.why: His attributes are without beginning and without end, and creation added nothing to them.

cards.title: Lord with none lorded over
cards.ar: له معنى الربوبية ولا مربوب ومعنى الخالق ولا مخلوق
cards.en: He has the meaning of Lordship when there is no one to be lorded over, and the meaning of Creator when there is nothing created.

cards.ask: Which is true, as al-Tahawi says it?
options: Allah was Lord before there was anyone to be lorded over
Allah became Lord once there were servants
Allah was the Creator only in name, before He created anything
cards.source: له معنى الربوبية ولا مربوب
cards.why: He has the meaning of Lordship even when there is no one lorded over.

cards.title: His example: Giver of life
cards.ar: وكما أنه محيي الموتى بعدما أحيا استحق هذا الاسم قبل إحيائهم كذلك استحق اسم الخالق قبل إنشائهم
cards.en: His example: Allah is "Giver of life to the dead" after giving them life, yet He deserved the name before giving them life. In the same way He deserved the name Creator before bringing them into being.

cards.ask: Al-Tahawi's example: Allah deserved the name "Giver of life to the dead"...
options: Only on the Day of Rising
cards.source: استحق هذا الاسم قبل إحيائهم
cards.why: He deserved this name before giving them life, as He deserved the name Creator before creating.

cards.title: Power over everything
cards.ar: ذلك بأنه على كل شيء قدير وكل شيء إليه فقير وكل أمر عليه يسير لا يحتاج إلى شيء
cards.en: That is because He has power over everything, everything is in need of Him, every matter is easy for Him, and He needs nothing.

cards.ask: Which does al-Tahawi say?

options.text: Everything is in need of Him
Every matter is easy for Him
He needs creation to be called Creator
Some matters are hard for Him

cards.source: ذلك بأنه على كل شيء قدير وكل شيء إليه فقير وكل أمر عليه يسير لا يحتاج إلى شيء
cards.why: All four are his words; he needs nothing, so not even His names wait on creation.

cards.title: Nothing is like Him
cards.ar: ليس كمثله شيء وهو السميع البصير
cards.en: He seals it with the ayah: "There is nothing like Him, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing" (42:11).

cards.ask: Which word completes al-Tahawi's statement?
cards.ar: ليس كمثله شيء وهو السميع ____
cards.source: ليس كمثله شيء وهو السميع البصير
cards.why: البصير: the ayah ends "the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing".

cards.ask: Sort: what al-Tahawi affirms of Allah, and what he denies.
source: له معنى الربوبية ولا مربوب
على كل شيء قدير
لا يحتاج إلى شيء ليس كمثله شيء وهو السميع البصير
cards.why: He affirms His hearing, seeing, power and Lordship, and denies that He needs anything or that anything is like Him.

cards.ask: What does al-Tahawi say everything is towards Allah?
options: Equal to Him in some things
cards.source: وكل شيء إليه فقير
cards.why: Kullu shay'in ilayhi faqir: everything is in need of Him.

cards.title: He created and measured
cards.ar: خلق الخلق بعمله وقدر لهم أقدارا وضرب لهم آجالا
cards.en: He created the creation, set measures (aqdar) for them, and fixed their terms (ajal): the set length of each one's life.

cards.ask: Which does al-Tahawi say Allah did for His creation?

options.text: Let them set their own measures

cards.source: خلق الخلق بعمله وقدر لهم أقدارا وضرب لهم آجالا
cards.why: He created them, measured out what is theirs, and fixed the term of each life.

cards.ask: Which word completes al-Tahawi's statement?
cards.ar: وضرب لهم ____
cards.source: وضرب لهم آجالا
cards.why: آجالا: He fixed their terms, the length of each life.

cards.ask: What is an ajal (أجل), in "He fixed their terms"?
options: The set length of a life
A reward for a good deed
cards.source: وضرب لهم آجالا
cards.why: Each one's ajal is the term of his life, which Allah has fixed.

cards.title: He knew before creating
cards.ar: ولم يخف عليه شيء قبل أن يخلقهم وعلم ما هم عاملون قبل أن يخلقهم
cards.en: Nothing about them was hidden from Him before He created them, and He knew what they would do before He created them.

cards.ask: When did Allah know what people would do, al-Tahawi says?
options: Once they had made up their minds
cards.source: وعلم ما هم عاملون قبل أن يخلقهم
cards.why: He knew what they would do before He created them.

cards.ask: Which is true, as al-Tahawi says it?
options: Nothing about people was hidden from Allah before He made them
Allah comes to know people as they act
Allah knew how many people there would be, but not their deeds
cards.source: ولم يخف عليه شيء قبل أن يخلقهم
cards.why: Nothing about them was hidden from Him, before He created them.

cards.ask: Put al-Tahawi's statements in his order.
steps: He knew what they would do before creating them
source: خلق الخلق بعمله وقدر لهم أقدارا وضرب لهم آجالا
وعلم ما هم عاملون قبل أن يخلقهم
cards.why: Created, measured, given their terms, and all of it known to Him before He created them.

cards.title: Command and forbidding
cards.ar: وأمرهم بطاعته ونهاهم عن معصيته
cards.en: He commanded them to obey Him and forbade them from disobeying Him.

cards.title: Everything by His will
cards.ar: وكل شيء يجري بتقديره ومشيئته ومشيئته تنفذ لا مشيئة للعباد إلا ما شاء لهم
cards.en: Everything runs by His decree (taqdir) and His will (mashi'a). His will is carried out; servants have no will except what He wills for them.

cards.ask: Which is true, as al-Tahawi says it?
options: Servants will nothing except what Allah wills for them
Servants' will runs apart from Allah's will
Allah's will is sometimes left undone by His servants
cards.source: ومشيئته تنفذ لا مشيئة للعباد إلا ما شاء لهم
cards.why: His will is carried out, and servants have no will except what He wills for them.

cards.title: What He wills happens
cards.ar: فما شاء لهم كان وما لم يشأ لم يكن
cards.en: So what He wills for them happens, and what He does not will does not happen.

cards.ask: Which word completes al-Tahawi's statement?
cards.ar: فما شاء لهم ____ وما لم يشأ لم يكن
cards.source: فما شاء لهم كان وما لم يشأ لم يكن
cards.why: كان: what He wills for them happens.

cards.title: Grace and justice
cards.ar: يهدي من يشاء ويعصم ويعافي فضلا ويضل من يشاء ويخذل ويبتلي عدلا
cards.en: He guides whom He wills, protects and keeps safe, out of His grace (fadl); and He leaves astray whom He wills, forsakes and tests, out of His justice ('adl).

cards.ask: Sort: which does al-Tahawi say is out of His grace, and which out of His justice?
cards.source: يهدي من يشاء ويعصم ويعافي فضلا ويضل من يشاء ويخذل ويبتلي عدلا
cards.why: Guiding, protecting and keeping safe are fadl, grace; leaving astray, forsaking and testing are 'adl, justice.

cards.title: All within His will
cards.ar: وكلهم يتقلبون في مشيئته بين فضله وعدله
cards.en: All of them turn about within His will, between His grace and His justice.

cards.ask: Between which two does al-Tahawi say all people turn about?
options: Their deeds and their fathers' deeds
cards.source: وكلهم يتقلبون في مشيئته بين فضله وعدله
cards.why: They turn about within His will, between His grace and His justice.

cards.ask: Which of these does al-Tahawi affirm?

options.text: Everything runs by Allah's decree and will
Allah commanded obedience and forbade disobedience
Servants' will can overrule Allah's will
Allah guides out of justice and leaves astray out of grace

source: وأمرهم بطاعته ونهاهم عن معصيته
وكل شيء يجري بتقديره ومشيئته ومشيئته تنفذ
cards.why: He commanded and forbade, and everything runs by His decree and will, which is carried out. Guiding is grace; leaving astray is justice.

cards.title: No opposite, no rival
cards.ar: وهو متعال عن الأضداد والأنداد
cards.en: He is exalted above opposites (addad) and rivals (andad): none stands against Him and none is His equal.

cards.title: Three 'none's
cards.ar: لا راد لقضائه ولا معقب لحكمه ولا غالب لأمره
cards.en: None can turn back His decree (qada'), none can revise His judgement (hukm), and none can overcome His command (amr).

cards.ask: Which word completes al-Tahawi's statement?
cards.ar: لا راد ____ ولا معقب لحكمه
cards.source: لا راد لقضائه ولا معقب لحكمه
cards.why: لقضائه: none can turn back His decree.

cards.ask: Which does al-Tahawi say?

options.text: None can turn back His decree
None may ask Him for help

cards.source: لا راد لقضائه ولا معقب لحكمه ولا غالب لأمره
cards.why: His three 'none's: decree, judgement and command.

cards.title: All of it from Him
cards.ar: آمنا بذلك كله وأيقنا أن كلا من عنده
cards.en: We believe in all of that, and are certain that all of it is from Him.

cards.ask: What does al-Tahawi say Allah is exalted above?
cards.source: وهو متعال عن الأضداد والأنداد
cards.why: He is exalted above addad and andad: opposites and rivals.

cards.ask: Which is true, as al-Tahawi says it?
options: We are certain all of it is from Allah
Only the good of it is from Allah
Some of it is from Allah, and some from chance
cards.source: وأيقنا أن كلا من عنده
cards.why: We are certain that all of it is from Him.

cards.ask: Sort: what al-Tahawi affirms, and what he denies.
items: One who turns back His decree
All of it is from Allah
source: وهو متعال عن الأضداد والأنداد
لا راد لقضائه ولا معقب لحكمه ولا غالب لأمره
أن كلا من عنده
ومشيئته تنفذ
cards.why: He has no rival, and none can turn back His decree or overcome His command; His will is done and all is from Him.

cards.ask: With what words does al-Tahawi end this section?
options: We believe in all of that
We leave all of that to the scholars
cards.source: آمنا بذلك كله
cards.why: Amanna bi-dhalika kullihi: we believe in all of it.

parts.title: The Prophet ﷺ and the Quran

cards.title: Servant, prophet, messenger
cards.ar: وأن محمدا عبده المصطفى ونبيه المجتبى ورسوله المرتضى
cards.en: And that Muhammad ﷺ is His chosen servant, His selected prophet, and His messenger with whom He is pleased.

cards.ask: What does al-Tahawi call Muhammad ﷺ here?

options.text: His messenger with whom He is pleased

cards.source: وأن محمدا عبده المصطفى ونبيه المجتبى ورسوله المرتضى
cards.why: Servant, prophet and messenger: chosen, selected, and pleasing to Allah.

cards.title: The Seal of the Prophets
cards.ar: وأنه خاتم الأنبياء وإمام الأتقياء وسيد المرسلين وحبيب رب العالمين
cards.en: He is the Seal of the Prophets, the leader (imam) of the God-fearing, the master of the messengers, and the beloved of the Lord of the worlds.

cards.ask: Which word completes al-Tahawi's statement?
cards.ar: وأنه ____ الأنبياء
cards.source: وأنه خاتم الأنبياء
cards.why: خاتم: he is the Seal, the last, of the prophets.

cards.title: No prophet after him
cards.ar: وكل دعوى النبوة بعده فغي وهوى
cards.en: Every claim to prophethood after him is error and desire.

cards.ask: Which is true, as al-Tahawi says it?
options: Every claim to prophethood after him is error
A prophet may still come with a new law
Prophethood is open to the most pious
cards.source: وكل دعوى النبوة بعده فغي وهوى
cards.why: He is the Seal, so every claim to prophethood after him is ghayy, error, and hawa, desire.

cards.title: Sent to jinn and mankind
cards.ar: وهو المبعوث إلى عامة الجن وكافة الورى بالحق والهدى وبالنور والضياء
cards.en: He is sent to all the jinn and all mankind, with truth and guidance, with light and radiance.

cards.ask: To whom was the Prophet ﷺ sent, al-Tahawi says?
options: All the jinn and all mankind
The people of Makka and Madina
cards.source: وهو المبعوث إلى عامة الجن وكافة الورى
cards.why: He is sent to all the jinn and all of mankind (al-wara).

cards.ask: What does al-Tahawi say he was sent with?
cards.source: بالحق والهدى وبالنور والضياء
cards.why: Bil-haqq wal-huda, wan-nur wad-diya': truth and guidance, light and radiance.

cards.ask: Sort: what al-Tahawi affirms, and what he rejects.
items: He is the Seal of the Prophets
He is sent to the jinn too
He was sent to one people only
He is the master of the messengers
source: وأنه خاتم الأنبياء وإمام الأتقياء وسيد المرسلين
وكل دعوى النبوة بعده فغي وهوى
وهو المبعوث إلى عامة الجن وكافة الورى
cards.why: He is the Seal and master of the messengers, sent to jinn and mankind; any claim to prophethood after him is error.

cards.title: Allah's speech
cards.ar: وإن القرآن كلام الله منه بدا بلا كيفية قولا
cards.en: The Quran is the speech (kalam) of Allah. It came from Him as speech, without any "how" (bila kayfiyya).

cards.title: Sent down as revelation
cards.ar: وأنزله على رسوله وحيا وصدقه المؤمنون على ذلك حقا
cards.en: He sent it down on His Messenger as revelation (wahy), and the believers affirmed it as truly so.

cards.ask: What is the Quran, in al-Tahawi's first words on it?
cards.source: وإن القرآن كلام الله
cards.why: He begins: the Quran is kalam Allah, the speech of Allah.

cards.title: Not created
cards.ar: وأيقنوا أنه كلام الله تعالى بالحقيقة ليس بمخلوق ككلام البرية
cards.en: They were certain it is truly Allah's speech, not created like the speech of creatures.

cards.ask: Which word completes al-Tahawi's statement?
cards.ar: ليس ____ ككلام البرية
cards.source: ليس بمخلوق ككلام البرية
cards.why: بمخلوق: it is not created like the speech of creatures.

cards.ask: Which does al-Tahawi say of the Quran?

options.text: It is the speech of Allah
It came from Him as speech, without a "how"
He sent it down on His Messenger as revelation
It is not created like the speech of creatures
It is the Prophet's own words
It is like the speech of people

source: وإن القرآن كلام الله منه بدا بلا كيفية قولا وأنزله على رسوله وحيا
ليس بمخلوق ككلام البرية
cards.why: All four are his words; it is Allah's speech, not the words of a human.

cards.ask: How did the believers receive it, al-Tahawi says?
options: They affirmed it as truly so
They took it as fine poetry by the Prophet
cards.source: وصدقه المؤمنون على ذلك حقا
cards.why: The believers affirmed it, truly, and were certain it is Allah's speech.

cards.ask: Put al-Tahawi's words on the Quran in his order.
steps: He sent it down on His Messenger
cards.source: وإن القرآن كلام الله منه بدا بلا كيفية قولا وأنزله على رسوله وحيا وصدقه المؤمنون على ذلك حقا وأيقنوا أنه كلام الله تعالى بالحقيقة ليس بمخلوق
cards.why: Allah's speech, sent down, affirmed by the believers, and known for certain to be uncreated.

cards.ask: What does بلا كيفية (bila kayfiyya) say, here?
cards.source: منه بدا بلا كيفية قولا
cards.why: Kayfiyya is the "how" of a thing: it came from Him as speech, without a how.

lessons.title: Not the word of a human

cards.title: Calling it human speech
cards.ar: فمن سمعه فزعم أنه كلام البشر فقد كفر
cards.en: Whoever hears it and claims it is human speech has disbelieved.

cards.title: The threat of Saqar
cards.ar: وقد ذمه الله وعابه وأوعده بسقر حيث قال تعالى سأصليه سقر
cards.en: Allah blamed and faulted such a man, and threatened him with Saqar, a name of Hell, where He said: "I will burn him in Saqar" (74:26).

cards.ask: What does al-Tahawi say of one who hears the Quran and claims it is human speech?
options: He has made a small slip
He is excused if he is learned
cards.source: فمن سمعه فزعم أنه كلام البشر فقد كفر
cards.why: Faqad kafar: he has disbelieved.

cards.title: The word of the Creator
cards.ar: فلما أوعد الله بسقر لمن قال إن هذا إلا قول البشر علمنا وأيقنا أنه قول خالق البشر ولا يشبه قول البشر
cards.en: Since Allah threatened Saqar for whoever said "This is nothing but the word of a human" (74:25), we know for certain it is the word of the Creator of humans, and not like human speech.

cards.ask: Which word completes al-Tahawi's statement?
cards.ar: علمنا وأيقنا أنه قول ____ البشر
cards.source: علمنا وأيقنا أنه قول خالق البشر
cards.why: خالق: it is the word of the Creator of humans.

cards.ask: What is Saqar, in the ayah al-Tahawi quotes?
cards.source: وأوعده بسقر
cards.why: Allah threatened the one who called it human speech with Saqar: the Fire.

cards.title: No human meaning
cards.ar: ومن وصف الله بمعنى من معاني البشر فقد كفر
cards.en: And whoever describes Allah with a meaning from the meanings of humans has disbelieved.

cards.title: Take heed
cards.ar: فمن أبصر هذا اعتبر وعن مثل قول الكفار انزجر وعلم أنه بصفاته ليس كالبشر
cards.en: Whoever sees this takes heed, keeps away from saying what the disbelievers said, and knows that Allah, in His attributes, is not like humans.

cards.ask: Which is true, as al-Tahawi says it?
options: Allah, in His attributes, is not like humans
Allah's attributes are like ours, only greater
Whoever likens Allah to humans is excused
cards.source: وعلم أنه بصفاته ليس كالبشر
cards.why: He is not like humans in His attributes; whoever describes Him with a human meaning has disbelieved.

cards.ask: Which does al-Tahawi say in this passage?

options.text: The Quran is the word of the Creator of humans
The Quran is not like human speech
Describing Allah with a human meaning is disbelief
The Quran is the word of a human
Allah's attributes are like those of humans

source: أنه قول خالق البشر ولا يشبه قول البشر
ومن وصف الله بمعنى من معاني البشر فقد كفر
cards.why: The Quran is the Creator's word, not like human speech, and Allah is not described with human meanings.

parts.title: Seeing Allah, the Mi'raj and the Hawd

cards.title: The people of Paradise see Him
cards.ar: والرؤية حق لأهل الجنة بغير إحاطة ولا كيفية
cards.en: The Vision (ru'ya) is true for the people of Paradise: they will see their Lord, without encompassing Him and without any "how".

cards.title: As the Book says
cards.ar: كما نطق به كتاب ربنا وجوه يومئذ ناضرة إلى ربها ناظرة
cards.en: As the Book of our Lord says: "Faces that Day will be radiant, looking at their Lord" (75:22–23).

cards.ask: Who will see Allah, al-Tahawi says?
cards.source: والرؤية حق لأهل الجنة
cards.why: The Vision is true for ahl al-janna, the people of Paradise.

cards.ask: Which word completes al-Tahawi's statement?
cards.ar: إلى ربها ____
cards.source: إلى ربها ناظرة
cards.why: ناظرة: faces that Day will be looking at their Lord.

cards.title: Its meaning is as Allah intended
cards.ar: وتفسيره على ما أراده الله تعالى وعلمه
cards.en: Its explanation is as Allah intended it and knows it.

cards.title: The sound hadith on it
cards.ar: وكل ما جاء في ذلك من الحديث الصحيح عن الرسول صلى الله عليه وسلم فهو كما قال ومعناه على ما أراد
cards.en: Every sound (sahih) hadith from the Messenger ﷺ about it is as he said, and its meaning is as he intended.

cards.ask: How does al-Tahawi say the Vision will be?
options: Without encompassing Him and without any "how"
With the eyes taking in all of Him
Only in a dream, in this world, for the best of the believers
cards.source: بغير إحاطة ولا كيفية
cards.why: Bi-ghayri ihata wa la kayfiyya: without encompassing, and without a how.

cards.title: Not by our opinions
cards.ar: لا ندخل في ذلك متأولين بآرائنا ولا متوهمين بأهوائنا
cards.en: We do not enter into it, reinterpreting it by our opinions or imagining it by our desires.

cards.ask: Which does al-Tahawi say about the Vision?

options.text: It is true for the people of Paradise
Its explanation is as Allah intended
The sound hadith on it are as the Messenger said
We reinterpret it by our own opinions
We picture how it will be

source: والرؤية حق لأهل الجنة
وتفسيره على ما أراده الله تعالى وعلمه
فهو كما قال
لا ندخل في ذلك متأولين بآرائنا ولا متوهمين بأهوائنا
cards.why: It is true, its meaning is as Allah and His Messenger intended, and we do not reinterpret it by opinion or picture it by desire.

cards.title: Who is safe
cards.ar: فإنه ما سلم في دينه إلا من سلم لله عز وجل ولرسوله صلى الله عليه وسلم ورد علم ما اشتبه عليه إلى عالمه
cards.en: For none is safe in his religion except one who submits to Allah and His Messenger ﷺ, and refers the knowledge of what is unclear to him back to the One who knows it.

cards.ask: Who is safe in his religion, al-Tahawi says?
options: One who submits to Allah and His Messenger
One who argues every question out until he wins
One who follows his own reasoning alone
cards.source: فإنه ما سلم في دينه إلا من سلم لله عز وجل ولرسوله
cards.why: Only one who submits to Allah and His Messenger, and refers what is unclear to Allah.

cards.title: The foot of Islam
cards.ar: ولا تثبت قدم الإسلام إلا على ظهر التسليم والاستسلام
cards.en: The foot of Islam stands firm only on the ground of submission (taslim) and surrender (istislam).

cards.title: Seeking what is barred
cards.ar: فمن رام علم ما حظر عنه علمه ولم يقنع بالتسليم فهمه حجبه مرامه عن خالص التوحيد وصافي المعرفة وصحيح الإيمان
cards.en: Whoever seeks knowledge barred from him, his understanding not content to submit, is veiled by his seeking from pure tawhid, clear knowledge of Allah (ma'rifa) and sound iman.

cards.ask: Which word completes al-Tahawi's statement?
cards.ar: ولا تثبت قدم الإسلام إلا على ظهر ____ والاستسلام
cards.source: ولا تثبت قدم الإسلام إلا على ظهر التسليم والاستسلام
cards.why: التسليم: Islam stands firm only on submission and surrender.

cards.title: He wavers
cards.ar: فيتذبذب بين الكفر والإيمان والتصديق والتكذيب والإقرار والإنكار موسوسا تائها شاكا لا مؤمنا مصدقا ولا جاحدا مكذبا
cards.en: So he wavers between disbelief and belief, affirming and denying, accepting and rejecting: troubled by whispers, lost, doubting; neither a believer who affirms nor a denier who rejects.

cards.ask: What happens to the one who will not submit, al-Tahawi says?
options: He wavers, doubting, neither believer nor denier
He reaches a deeper knowledge of Allah than those who submit
He becomes certain by his own reason
cards.source: فيتذبذب بين الكفر والإيمان
cards.why: He wavers between disbelief and belief, a doubter, neither a believer nor a denier.

cards.title: Belief in the Vision
cards.ar: ولا يصح الإيمان بالرؤية لأهل دار السلام لمن اعتبرها منهم بوهم أو تأولها بفهم
cards.en: Belief in the Vision for the people of the Abode of Peace is not sound for one who pictures it by his imagination or reinterprets it by his own understanding.

cards.title: Neither denial nor likening
cards.ar: ومن لم يتوق النفي والتشبيه زل ولم يصب التنزيه
cards.en: Whoever does not guard against both denial (nafy) and likening (tashbih) slips, and does not reach true transcendence (tanzih).

cards.ask: Which two does al-Tahawi say one must guard against?
cards.source: ومن لم يتوق النفي والتشبيه زل ولم يصب التنزيه
cards.why: Guard against nafy and tashbih; whoever does not, slips and misses tanzih.

cards.title: None shares His meaning
cards.ar: فإن ربنا جل وعلا موصوف بصفات الوحدانية منعوت بنعوت الفردانية ليس في معناه أحد من البرية
cards.en: For our Lord is described with the attributes of oneness and the qualities of uniqueness; no creature shares in His meaning.

cards.title: Exalted above limits
cards.ar: وتعالى عن الحدود والغايات والأركان والأعضاء والأدوات لا تحويه الجهات الست كسائر المبتدعات
cards.en: He is exalted above limits and ends, parts, limbs and instruments. The six directions do not contain Him as they contain all created things. Note: later schools explain this line in different ways.

cards.ask: Which is true, as al-Tahawi says it?
options: No creature shares in Allah's meaning
Some creatures share in His attributes
His attributes are those of created things
cards.source: ليس في معناه أحد من البرية
cards.why: Laysa fi ma'nahu ahadun min al-bariyya: no creature shares in His meaning.

cards.title: The Mi'raj is true
cards.ar: والمعراج حق وقد أسرى بالنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وعرج بشخصه في اليقظة إلى السماء
cards.en: The Mi'raj (Ascension) is true. Allah took the Prophet ﷺ by night and raised him, in his person and awake, to the heaven.

cards.ask: How was the Prophet ﷺ raised, al-Tahawi says?
cards.source: وعرج بشخصه في اليقظة
cards.why: Bi-shakhsihi fil-yaqaza: in his person, and awake.

cards.title: To the heights
cards.ar: ثم إلى حيث شاء الله من العلا وأكرمه الله بما شاء وأوحى إليه ما أوحى
cards.en: Then on to wherever Allah willed of the heights. Allah honoured him with what He willed, and revealed to him what He revealed.

cards.title: The heart did not deny
cards.ar: ما كذب الفؤاد ما رأى
cards.en: "The heart did not deny what it saw" (53:11). Then al-Tahawi sends blessings on him ﷺ, in the next life and in this one.

cards.ask: Put the journey in al-Tahawi's order.
steps: He was raised to the heaven
Then to wherever Allah willed of the heights
Allah revealed to him what He revealed
cards.source: وقد أسرى بالنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وعرج بشخصه في اليقظة إلى السماء ثم إلى حيث شاء الله من العلا وأكرمه الله بما شاء وأوحى إليه ما أوحى
cards.why: By night, up to the heaven, then to the heights Allah willed, where He revealed to him what He revealed.

cards.ask: Which word completes al-Tahawi's statement?
cards.ar: وعرج بشخصه في ____ إلى السماء
cards.source: وعرج بشخصه في اليقظة إلى السماء
cards.why: اليقظة: he was raised awake, not in a dream.

cards.ask: Which does al-Tahawi affirm about the Mi'raj?

options.text: It was while he was awake
Allah honoured him with what He willed
It went no further than Jerusalem

source: والمعراج حق
وعرج بشخصه في اليقظة إلى السماء
وأكرمه الله بما شاء
cards.why: True, in his person, awake, up to the heaven and beyond, honoured by Allah.

cards.ask: How far was he raised, al-Tahawi says?
options: To the heaven, then as high as Allah willed
Only to the first heaven, then straight back
To Jerusalem, and no further than that
cards.source: إلى السماء ثم إلى حيث شاء الله من العلا
cards.why: To the heaven, then to wherever Allah willed of the heights.

cards.ask: Which ayah does al-Tahawi quote on the Mi'raj?
options: "The heart did not deny what it saw"
cards.source: ما كذب الفؤاد ما رأى
cards.why: Ma kadhaba al-fu'adu ma ra'a (53:11).

lessons.title: The Pool, the Intercession, the Covenant

cards.title: The Hawd
cards.ar: والحوض الذي أكرمه الله تعالى به غياثا لأمته حق
cards.en: The Hawd (the Pool) is true: Allah honoured the Prophet ﷺ with it, as relief for his umma.

cards.ask: What is the Hawd, as al-Tahawi describes it?
options: Relief for his umma, an honour from Allah
A river of this world that runs near Makka
A wall standing between Paradise and Hell
cards.source: والحوض الذي أكرمه الله تعالى به غياثا لأمته حق
cards.why: Allah honoured the Prophet with the Hawd, as ghiyath, relief, for his umma.

cards.title: The Intercession
cards.ar: والشفاعة التي ادخرها لهم حق كما روي في الأخبار
cards.en: The Intercession (shafa'a) he has stored up for them is true, as related in the reports.

cards.title: The Covenant
cards.ar: والميثاق الذي أخذه الله تعالى من آدم وذريته حق
cards.en: The Covenant (mithaq) that Allah took from Adam and his descendants is true.

cards.ask: Which does al-Tahawi call true (haqq) here?
source: والحوض الذي أكرمه الله تعالى به غياثا لأمته حق
والشفاعة التي ادخرها لهم حق
والميثاق الذي أخذه الله تعالى من آدم وذريته حق
cards.why: Each of the three ends with haqq: it is true.

cards.ask: Which word completes al-Tahawi's statement?
cards.ar: والشفاعة التي ____ لهم حق
cards.source: والشفاعة التي ادخرها لهم حق
cards.why: ادخرها: the Intercession he stored up for them.

cards.ask: Sort each description under what al-Tahawi says it of.
items: Taken from Adam and his descendants
An honour Allah gave the Prophet
source: والحوض الذي أكرمه الله تعالى به غياثا لأمته حق
والشفاعة التي ادخرها لهم حق كما روي في الأخبار
من آدم وذريته
cards.why: The Hawd is an honour and relief; the Intercession is stored up, as the reports say; the Covenant was taken from Adam and his descendants.

cards.ask: From whom did Allah take the Covenant, al-Tahawi says?
options: The angels, before Adam was made
cards.source: والميثاق الذي أخذه الله تعالى من آدم وذريته حق
cards.why: He took it from Adam and his descendants (dhurriyya).

cards.ask: Which is true, as al-Tahawi says it?
options: The Intercession is true, as related in the reports
There is no intercession on the Last Day
The Hawd is only a parable
cards.source: والشفاعة التي ادخرها لهم حق كما روي في الأخبار
cards.why: The Intercession is true, as related in the reports.

parts.title: The Pen, the Tablet and the Throne

cards.title: The number is known
cards.ar: وقد علم الله تعالى فيما لم يزل عدد من يدخل الجنة وعدد من يدخل النار جملة واحدة فلا يزاد في ذلك العدد ولا ينقص منه
cards.en: Allah has always known the number who will enter Paradise and the number who will enter the Fire, all at once. That number is not added to or taken from.

cards.ask: Can the number of those who enter Paradise change, al-Tahawi says?
options: No: it is not added to or taken from
Yes: it grows as people do good
Yes: it is set again each year
cards.source: فلا يزاد في ذلك العدد ولا ينقص منه
cards.why: Allah has always known it, and it is not added to or taken from.

cards.title: Each is eased
cards.ar: وكذلك أفعالهم فيما علم منهم أن يفعلوه وكل ميسر لما خلق له
cards.en: So too their deeds: He knew what they would do. And everyone is eased towards what he was created for.

cards.title: Deeds by their endings
cards.ar: والأعمال بالخواتيم والسعيد من سعد بقضاء الله والشقي من شقي بقضاء الله
cards.en: Deeds go by their endings. The happy one is happy by Allah's decree, and the wretched one is wretched by Allah's decree.

cards.ask: Which word completes al-Tahawi's statement?
cards.ar: والأعمال ____
cards.source: والأعمال بالخواتيم
cards.why: بالخواتيم: deeds go by how they end.

cards.title: The secret of the decree
cards.ar: وأصل القدر سر الله تعالى في خلقه لم يطلع على ذلك ملك مقرب ولا نبي مرسل
cards.en: The root of the decree (qadar) is Allah's secret in His creation. No angel brought near and no prophet sent has been shown it.

cards.ask: Who has been shown the root of the decree, al-Tahawi says?
cards.source: لم يطلع على ذلك ملك مقرب ولا نبي مرسل
cards.why: It is Allah's secret: not even an angel brought near or a prophet sent has been shown it.

cards.title: Beware of probing it
cards.ar: والتعمق والنظر في ذلك ذريعة الخذلان وسلم الحرمان ودرجة الطغيان فالحذر كل الحذر من ذلك نظرا وفكرا ووسوسة
cards.en: Delving and probing into it is a means to being forsaken, a ladder to being deprived, and a step to transgression. So beware, utterly beware, of it: in looking, in thinking and in whispered thoughts.

cards.ask: What does al-Tahawi say delving into the decree is?
cards.source: والتعمق والنظر في ذلك ذريعة الخذلان وسلم الحرمان ودرجة الطغيان
cards.why: Dhari'a, sullam and daraja: a means, a ladder and a step, all downward.

cards.title: Folded away
cards.ar: فإن الله تعالى طوى علم القدر عن أنامه ونهاهم عن مرامه كما قال الله تعالى في كتابه لا يسأل عما يفعل وهم يسألون
cards.en: For Allah has folded away knowledge of the decree from His creatures and forbidden them from seeking it, as He says: "He is not asked about what He does, but they will be asked" (21:23).

cards.title: Asking "why?"
cards.ar: فمن سأل لم فعل فقد رد حكم الكتاب ومن رد حكم الكتاب كان من الكافرين
cards.en: So whoever asks "Why did He do it?" has rejected the ruling of the Book, and whoever rejects the ruling of the Book is among the disbelievers.

cards.ask: What does al-Tahawi say of one who asks of Allah "Why did He do it?"
options: He has rejected the ruling of the Book
He has asked a fine question that scholars must answer
cards.source: فمن سأل لم فعل فقد رد حكم الكتاب
cards.why: Allah "is not asked about what He does"; asking why rejects the ruling of the Book.

cards.title: The sum of it
cards.ar: فهذا جملة ما يحتاج إليه من هو منور قلبه من أولياء الله تعالى وهي درجة الراسخين في العلم
cards.en: This is the sum of what is needed by one whose heart is lit, among the friends (awliya) of Allah. It is the rank of those firmly grounded in knowledge.

cards.title: Found and missing
cards.ar: لأن العلم علمان علم في الخلق موجود وعلم في الخلق مفقود
cards.en: For knowledge is of two kinds: knowledge found among creation, and knowledge missing from creation.

cards.ask: How many kinds of knowledge does al-Tahawi name here?
cards.source: لأن العلم علمان
cards.why: Al-'ilmu 'ilman: knowledge is two, found and missing.

cards.title: Both are disbelief
cards.ar: فإنكار العلم الموجود كفر وادعاء العلم المفقود كفر
cards.en: Denying the knowledge that is found is disbelief, and claiming the knowledge that is missing is disbelief.

cards.ask: Sort: which does al-Tahawi call disbelief, and which does iman need?
source: فإنكار العلم الموجود كفر وادعاء العلم المفقود كفر
ولا يثبت الإيمان إلا بقبول العلم الموجود وترك طلب العلم المفقود
cards.why: Denying what is found and claiming what is missing are both kufr; iman stands on accepting the one and not seeking the other.

cards.title: Where iman stands
cards.ar: ولا يثبت الإيمان إلا بقبول العلم الموجود وترك طلب العلم المفقود
cards.en: Iman stands firm only by accepting the knowledge that is found and leaving off seeking the knowledge that is missing.

cards.ask: Which word completes al-Tahawi's statement?
cards.ar: وادعاء العلم ____ كفر
cards.source: وادعاء العلم المفقود كفر
cards.why: المفقود: claiming the missing knowledge is disbelief.

cards.ask: Whose rank does al-Tahawi call this?
options: Those who probe into the secret of the decree
cards.source: وهي درجة الراسخين في العلم
cards.why: Darajat al-rasikhina fil-'ilm: the rank of those firmly grounded in knowledge.

cards.ask: Which is true, as al-Tahawi says it?
options: Claiming the missing knowledge is disbelief
Claiming the missing knowledge is a high rank
Denying the found knowledge is allowed
cards.source: وادعاء العلم المفقود كفر
cards.why: Claiming the knowledge missing from creation is kufr.

cards.ask: What does iman need, al-Tahawi says?

options.text: Accepting the knowledge that is found
Leaving off seeking the knowledge that is missing
Seeking the knowledge that is missing
Doubting the knowledge that is found

cards.source: ولا يثبت الإيمان إلا بقبول العلم الموجود وترك طلب العلم المفقود
cards.why: Accept what is found; do not seek what is missing.

cards.title: The Tablet and the Pen
cards.ar: ونؤمن باللوح والقلم وبجميع ما فيه قد رقم
cards.en: We believe in the Tablet (al-Lawh) and the Pen (al-Qalam), and in all that is written in it.

cards.title: If all creation gathered
cards.ar: فلو اجتمع الخلق كلهم على شيء كتبه الله تعالى فيه أنه كائن ليجعلوه غير كائن لم يقدروا عليه
cards.en: If all creation gathered to stop something Allah wrote in it as coming to be, they could not do it.

cards.ask: If all creation gathered to stop something written in the Tablet, al-Tahawi says...
options: They could stop part of it
They could hold it back a while
cards.source: ليجعلوه غير كائن لم يقدروا عليه
cards.why: Lam yaqdiru 'alayh: they would not be able to.

cards.title: Nor the unwritten
cards.ar: ولو اجتمعوا كلهم على شيء لم يكتبه الله تعالى فيه ليجعلوه كائنا لم يقدروا عليه
cards.en: And if they all gathered to bring about something He did not write in it, they could not do that either.

cards.title: The Pen has dried
cards.ar: جف القلم بما هو كائن إلى يوم القيامة
cards.en: The Pen has dried with all that will be, until the Day of Rising.

cards.ask: Which word completes al-Tahawi's statement?
cards.ar: جف ____ بما هو كائن إلى يوم القيامة
cards.source: جف القلم بما هو كائن إلى يوم القيامة
cards.why: القلم: the Pen has dried with all that will be.

cards.title: What missed you
cards.ar: وما أخطأ العبد لم يكن ليصيبه وما أصابه لم يكن ليخطئه
cards.en: What missed the servant was never going to reach him, and what reached him was never going to miss him.

cards.ask: Which is true, as al-Tahawi says it?
options: What reached you was never going to miss you
What missed you might have reached you with more effort
What reached you could have been turned away
cards.source: وما أصابه لم يكن ليخطئه
cards.why: What reached the servant was never going to miss him.

cards.title: His knowledge came first
cards.ar: وعلى العبد أن يعلم أن الله قد سبق علمه في كل كائن من خلقه فقدر ذلك تقديرا محكما مبرما
cards.en: The servant must know that Allah's knowledge came first in everything that comes to be, and He decreed it with a firm, settled decree.

cards.title: None can change it
cards.ar: ليس فيه ناقض ولا معقب ولا مزيل ولا مغير ولا ناقص ولا زائد من خلقه في سماواته وأرضه وذلك من عقد الإيمان وأصول المعرفة
cards.en: No one in His heavens and earth can undo it, revise it, remove it, change it, take from it or add to it. Knowing this is part of the bond of iman and the roots of knowing Allah.

cards.ask: Who can undo or change Allah's decree, al-Tahawi says?
options: No one in the heavens or the earth
The angels brought near, if Allah gives them leave
cards.source: ليس فيه ناقض ولا معقب ولا مزيل ولا مغير ولا ناقص ولا زائد من خلقه في سماواته وأرضه
cards.why: None of His creation, in His heavens or His earth.

cards.title: Woe to the opponent
cards.ar: فويل لمن صار لله تعالى في القدر خصيما وأحضر للنظر فيه قلبا سقيما
cards.en: So woe to whoever becomes Allah's opponent over the decree, and brings a sick heart to probe into it.

cards.ask: What does al-Tahawi say of one who becomes Allah's opponent over the decree?
options: He is rewarded for his effort
He is excused if he means well
cards.source: فويل لمن صار لله تعالى في القدر خصيما
cards.why: Fa-waylun: woe to him; he probes the unseen with a sick heart.

cards.title: The Throne and the Kursi
cards.ar: والعرش والكرسي حق وهو مستغن عن العرش وما دونه
cards.en: The Throne ('Arsh) and the Footstool (Kursi) are true. And He has no need of the Throne or of anything below it.

cards.ask: Which is true, as al-Tahawi says it?
options: Allah has no need of the Throne or anything below it
Allah needs the Throne to hold Him
The Throne and the Kursi are only parables, not real things
cards.source: وهو مستغن عن العرش وما دونه
cards.why: Mustaghnin 'an al-'arsh: He has no need of the Throne or anything below it.

cards.title: Encompassing all
cards.ar: محيط بكل شيء وفوقه وقد أعجز عن الإحاطة خلقه
cards.en: He encompasses everything and is above it, and He has made His creation unable to encompass Him. Note: later schools explain "above it" in different ways.

cards.ask: Which word completes al-Tahawi's statement?
cards.ar: وقد أعجز عن ____ خلقه
cards.source: وقد أعجز عن الإحاطة خلقه
cards.why: الإحاطة: His creation cannot encompass Him.

cards.title: Ibrahim and Musa
cards.ar: ونقول إن الله اتخذ إبراهيم خليلا وكلم الله موسى تكليما إيمانا وتصديقا وتسليما
cards.en: We say that Allah took Ibrahim as an intimate friend (khalil), and Allah spoke to Musa directly; we say it believing, affirming and submitting.

cards.ask: Whom did Allah take as His khalil, al-Tahawi says?
cards.source: إن الله اتخذ إبراهيم خليلا
cards.why: Allah took Ibrahim as khalil, an intimate friend.

cards.ask: To whom did Allah speak directly, al-Tahawi says?
cards.source: وكلم الله موسى تكليما
cards.why: Kallama Allahu Musa taklima: Allah spoke to Musa directly.

cards.title: Angels, prophets and books
cards.ar: ونؤمن بالملائكة والنبيين والكتب المنزلة على المرسلين ونشهد أنهم كانوا على الحق المبين
cards.en: We believe in the angels, the prophets and the books sent down on the messengers, and we bear witness that they were on clear truth.

cards.ask: Which does al-Tahawi say we believe in here?

options.text: The books sent down on the messengers
The prophets of the Arabs only

cards.source: ونؤمن بالملائكة والنبيين والكتب المنزلة على المرسلين
cards.why: All the angels, all the prophets and all the books sent down.

cards.ask: Sort: what al-Tahawi affirms, and what he denies.
items: The Throne and Kursi are true
source: والعرش والكرسي حق وهو مستغن عن العرش وما دونه
وقد أعجز عن الإحاطة خلقه
إن الله اتخذ إبراهيم خليلا وكلم الله موسى تكليما
cards.why: The Throne and Kursi are true but He needs neither; creation cannot encompass Him; He took Ibrahim as khalil and spoke to Musa.

parts.title: Iman, sins and the people of the qibla

cards.title: Muslims and believers
cards.ar: ونسمي أهل قبلتنا مسلمين مؤمنين ما داموا بما جاء به النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم معترفين وله بكل ما قاله وأخبر مصدقين
cards.en: We call the people of our qibla Muslims and believers, as long as they acknowledge what the Prophet ﷺ brought and affirm all he said and told.

cards.ask: What does al-Tahawi call the people of our qibla?
options: Believers, but only once they are scholars
cards.source: ونسمي أهل قبلتنا مسلمين مؤمنين
cards.why: Muslims and believers, as long as they acknowledge and affirm what the Prophet ﷺ brought.

cards.title: No plunging, no disputing
cards.ar: ولا نخوض في الله ولا نماري في دين الله
cards.en: We do not plunge into speculation about Allah, nor dispute about Allah's religion.

cards.title: No arguing about the Quran
cards.ar: ولا نجادل في القرآن ونشهد أنه كلام رب العالمين نزل به الروح الأمين فعلمه سيد المرسلين محمدا صلى الله عليه وسلم
cards.en: We do not argue about the Quran. We bear witness it is the speech of the Lord of the worlds; the Trustworthy Spirit brought it down and taught it to the master of the messengers, Muhammad ﷺ.

cards.ask: Which does al-Tahawi say we do NOT do?

options.text: Bear witness the Quran is Allah's speech
Call the people of the qibla Muslims

source: ولا نخوض في الله ولا نماري في دين الله
ولا نجادل في القرآن
cards.why: We do not plunge, dispute or argue; we do bear witness to the Quran and call the people of the qibla Muslims.

cards.title: Nothing equals it
cards.ar: وهو كلام الله تعالى لا يساويه شيء من كلام المخلوقين ولا نقول بخلقه ولا نخالف جماعة المسلمين
cards.en: It is Allah's speech; nothing of creatures' speech equals it. We do not say it is created, and we do not go against the community (jama'a) of the Muslims.

cards.title: No takfir for a sin
cards.ar: ولا نكفر أحدا من أهل القبلة بذنب ما لم يستحله
cards.en: We do not declare anyone of the people of the qibla a disbeliever for a sin, as long as he does not hold it lawful.

cards.ask: Which word completes al-Tahawi's statement?
cards.ar: ولا نكفر أحدا من أهل القبلة بذنب ما لم ____
cards.source: ولا نكفر أحدا من أهل القبلة بذنب ما لم يستحله
cards.why: يستحله: unless he holds the sin to be lawful.

cards.title: Sin still harms
cards.ar: ولا نقول لا يضر مع الإيمان ذنب لمن عمله
cards.en: Nor do we say that, with iman, a sin does no harm to the one who does it.

cards.ask: A Muslim of the qibla commits a sin, but does not hold it lawful. What does al-Tahawi say?
options: We do not call him a disbeliever for it
He has left Islam by that sin
His sin cannot harm him at all, given his iman
source: ولا نكفر أحدا من أهل القبلة بذنب ما لم يستحله
ولا نقول لا يضر مع الإيمان ذنب لمن عمله
cards.why: He is not called a disbeliever for it; yet we do not say the sin cannot harm him.

cards.ask: Sort: what al-Tahawi says we say, and what we do not say.
items: The people of the qibla are Muslims
With iman, a sin does no harm
The Quran is the speech of the Lord of the worlds
A Muslim is a disbeliever for any sin
source: ونسمي أهل قبلتنا مسلمين مؤمنين
ونشهد أنه كلام رب العالمين
ولا نقول بخلقه
ولا نكفر أحدا من أهل القبلة بذنب
ولا نقول لا يضر مع الإيمان ذنب لمن عمله
cards.why: We say they are Muslims and the Quran is Allah's speech; we do not say it is created, nor make takfir for a sin, nor say sin does no harm.

cards.title: For those who do good
cards.ar: نرجو للمحسنين من المؤمنين أن يعفو عنهم ويدخلهم الجنة برحمته ولا نأمن عليهم ولا نشهد لهم بالجنة
cards.en: For the believers who do good, we hope Allah pardons them and enters them into Paradise by His mercy. But we do not feel safe for them, nor testify that they are in Paradise.

cards.title: For those who do wrong
cards.ar: ونستغفر لمسيئهم ونخاف عليهم ولا نقنطهم
cards.en: For those of them who do wrong, we ask forgiveness and fear for them, but we do not make them despair.

cards.ask: Sort: what al-Tahawi says we do for each.
items: We do not testify they are in Paradise
We do not make them despair
source: نرجو للمحسنين من المؤمنين أن يعفو عنهم
ولا نشهد لهم بالجنة
ونستغفر لمسيئهم ونخاف عليهم ولا نقنطهم
cards.why: For the good-doers: hope, but no testimony of Paradise. For the wrongdoers: forgiveness asked, fear, and no despair.

cards.title: The way between
cards.ar: والأمن والإياس ينقلان عن ملة الإسلام وسبيل الحق بينهما لأهل القبلة
cards.en: Feeling safe (from Allah's punishment) and despairing (of His mercy) both take one out of the religion of Islam. The way of truth for the people of the qibla is between the two.

cards.ask: Which word completes al-Tahawi's statement?
cards.ar: وسبيل الحق ____ لأهل القبلة
cards.source: وسبيل الحق بينهما لأهل القبلة
cards.why: بينهما: the way of truth lies between the two.

cards.ask: Which two does al-Tahawi say take one out of the religion of Islam?
cards.source: والأمن والإياس ينقلان عن ملة الإسلام
cards.why: Al-amn wal-iyas: feeling safe and despairing.

cards.title: How one leaves iman
cards.ar: ولا يخرج العبد من الإيمان إلا بجحود ما أدخله فيه
cards.en: A servant does not leave iman except by denying what brought him into it.

cards.ask: How does a servant leave iman, al-Tahawi says?
options: Only by denying what brought him into it
By any sin at all, small or great, once done
By missing a single prayer through laziness
cards.source: ولا يخرج العبد من الإيمان إلا بجحود ما أدخله فيه
cards.why: Only by juhud, denying what brought him into iman.

cards.ask: Do we testify that a believer who does good is in Paradise, by al-Tahawi's words?
options: No: we hope for him, but do not testify
Yes: every good-doer is sure of Paradise
Yes, if he prays all five prayers
cards.source: ولا نأمن عليهم ولا نشهد لهم بالجنة
cards.why: We hope for them, but neither feel safe for them nor testify to Paradise for them.

cards.ask: Which does al-Tahawi say we do for the believers who do wrong?

options.text: Testify they are in the Fire

cards.source: ونستغفر لمسيئهم ونخاف عليهم ولا نقنطهم
cards.why: We ask forgiveness for them and fear for them, but do not make them despair.

cards.title: Tongue and heart
cards.ar: والإيمان هو الإقرار باللسان والتصديق بالجنان
cards.en: Iman is affirming with the tongue and assenting with the heart. Note: other schools of Ahl al-Sunna also name deeds in iman; this is al-Tahawi's wording.

cards.ask: Which word completes al-Tahawi's statement?
cards.ar: والإيمان هو الإقرار باللسان والتصديق ____
cards.source: والإيمان هو الإقرار باللسان والتصديق بالجنان
cards.why: بالجنان: assenting with the heart (janan).

cards.ask: Which two does al-Tahawi name in his words on iman?
cards.source: والإيمان هو الإقرار باللسان والتصديق بالجنان
cards.why: Al-iqrar bil-lisan wat-tasdiq bil-janan.

cards.title: All that is sound is true
cards.ar: وجميع ما صح عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم من الشرع والبيان كله حق
cards.en: All that is soundly reported from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, of law and of explanation, is all true.

cards.ask: What does al-Tahawi say of all that is soundly reported from the Messenger ﷺ?
options: Only what is in the Quran is true
Only the law, not the explanation
cards.source: وجميع ما صح عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم من الشرع والبيان كله حق
cards.why: Kulluhu haqq: all of it, law and explanation, is true.

cards.title: Iman is one
cards.ar: والإيمان واحد وأهله في أصله سواء
cards.en: Iman is one, and its people are equal in its root.

cards.title: How they differ
cards.ar: والتفاضل بينهم بالخشية والتقى ومخالفة الهوى وملازمة الأولى
cards.en: They differ in rank by awe of Allah (khashya), God-fearing (taqwa), going against desire, and keeping to what is best.

cards.ask: By what does al-Tahawi say believers differ in rank?
cards.source: والتفاضل بينهم بالخشية والتقى ومخالفة الهوى وملازمة الأولى
cards.why: Khashya, taqwa, going against hawa, and keeping to the best.

cards.title: All believers are awliya
cards.ar: والمؤمنون كلهم أولياء الرحمن وأكرمهم عند الله أطوعهم وأتبعهم للقرآن
cards.en: All the believers are friends (awliya) of the Most Merciful. The most honoured of them with Allah is the most obedient, the best follower of the Quran.

cards.ask: Who is most honoured with Allah, al-Tahawi says?
options: The most obedient, who best follows the Quran
The one born into the noblest family of the Arabs
The one with the most wealth
cards.source: وأكرمهم عند الله أطوعهم وأتبعهم للقرآن
cards.why: Akramuhum: the most obedient and the best follower of the Quran.

cards.ask: Who are the friends (awliya) of the Most Merciful, al-Tahawi says?
cards.source: والمؤمنون كلهم أولياء الرحمن
cards.why: Al-mu'minuna kulluhum: all the believers.

cards.title: What iman is in
cards.ar: والإيمان هو الإيمان بالله وملائكته وكتبه ورسله واليوم الآخر والقدر خيره وشره وحلوه ومره من الله تعالى
cards.en: Iman is to believe in Allah, His angels, His books, His messengers, the Last Day, and the decree: its good and bad, its sweet and bitter, all from Allah.

cards.ask: How many things does al-Tahawi list to believe in?
cards.source: والإيمان هو الإيمان بالله وملائكته وكتبه ورسله واليوم الآخر والقدر
cards.why: Allah, angels, books, messengers, the Last Day and the decree: six.

cards.ask: Put them in al-Tahawi's order.
cards.source: بالله وملائكته وكتبه ورسله واليوم الآخر والقدر
cards.why: Bi-llahi wa mala'ikatihi wa kutubihi wa rusulihi wal-yawmil-akhiri wal-qadar.

cards.title: No distinction between messengers
cards.ar: ونحن مؤمنون بذلك كله لا نفرق بين أحد من رسله ونصدقهم كلهم على ما جاؤوا به
cards.en: We believe in all of that. We make no distinction between any of His messengers, and we affirm all of them in what they brought.

cards.ask: Which is true, as al-Tahawi says it?
options: We make no distinction between any of His messengers
We affirm some messengers and leave the rest aside
Only the good of the decree is from Allah; the bad is from others
cards.source: لا نفرق بين أحد من رسله
cards.why: We affirm all of the messengers, and the decree's good and bad are both from Allah.

cards.title: The people of major sins
cards.ar: وأهل الكبائر من أمة محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم في النار لا يخلدون إذا ماتوا وهم موحدون وإن لم يكونوا تائبين
cards.en: The people of major sins (kaba'ir) of Muhammad's ﷺ umma do not stay in the Fire forever, if they die believing in tawhid, even if they did not repent.

cards.title: In His will
cards.ar: وهم في مشيئته وحكمه إن شاء غفر لهم وعفا عنهم بفضله
cards.en: They are in His will and judgement: if He wills, He forgives them and pardons them by His grace...

cards.ask: Do the people of major sins of this umma stay in the Fire forever, if they die on tawhid?
cards.source: في النار لا يخلدون إذا ماتوا وهم موحدون
cards.why: La yukhalladun: they do not stay forever, if they die on tawhid.

cards.title: Or punished, then brought out
cards.ar: وإن شاء عذبهم في النار بعدله ثم يخرجهم منها برحمته وشفاعة الشافعين من أهل طاعته ثم يبعثهم إلى جنته
cards.en: ...and if He wills, He punishes them in the Fire by His justice, then brings them out by His mercy and the intercession of those who obey Him, then sends them to His Paradise.

cards.ask: If Allah wills to punish such a person, put what al-Tahawi says follows in order.
steps: Punished in the Fire, by His justice
Brought out by His mercy and the intercession
cards.source: وإن شاء عذبهم في النار بعدله ثم يخرجهم منها برحمته وشفاعة الشافعين من أهل طاعته ثم يبعثهم إلى جنته
cards.why: Punishment by justice, then out by mercy and intercession, then on to Paradise.

cards.title: Why
cards.ar: وذلك بأن الله تعالى تولى أهل معرفته ولم يجعلهم في الدارين كأهل نكرته
cards.en: That is because Allah has taken charge of those who know Him, and has not made them, in either world, like those who deny Him.

cards.ask: Whose intercession does al-Tahawi say helps bring them out?
options: Those of His people who obey Him
Anyone they call on in the Fire
No one: there is no intercession
cards.source: وشفاعة الشافعين من أهل طاعته
cards.why: Shafa'at al-shafi'in min ahli ta'atihi: the intercession of those who obey Him.

cards.title: Behind the righteous and the sinful
cards.ar: ونرى الصلاة خلف كل بر وفاجر من أهل القبلة وعلى من مات منهم
cards.en: We hold to praying behind anyone of the people of the qibla, righteous or sinful, and praying over any of them who dies.

cards.ask: Behind whom does al-Tahawi say we pray?
options: Anyone of the qibla, righteous or sinful
Only a righteous scholar whose life we know well
Only a man of our own madhhab
cards.source: ونرى الصلاة خلف كل بر وفاجر من أهل القبلة
cards.why: Khalfa kulli barrin wa fajir: behind every righteous and sinful one of the qibla.

cards.title: We place no one
cards.ar: ولا ننزل أحدا منهم جنة ولا نارا
cards.en: We do not place anyone of them in Paradise or in the Fire.

cards.title: Their hidden selves to Allah
cards.ar: ولا نشهد عليهم بكفر ولا بشرك ولا بنفاق ما لم يظهر منهم شيء من ذلك ونذر سرائرهم إلى الله تعالى
cards.en: Nor do we testify to their disbelief, shirk or hypocrisy, as long as none of that shows from them. We leave their hidden selves to Allah.

cards.ask: Which does al-Tahawi say we do NOT do with the people of the qibla?

options.text: Place any of them in Paradise or the Fire
Testify to their hypocrisy when none of it shows
Pray the funeral prayer over them

source: ولا ننزل أحدا منهم جنة ولا نارا
ولا نشهد عليهم بكفر ولا بشرك ولا بنفاق ما لم يظهر منهم شيء من ذلك
cards.why: We pray behind them and over them; we do not place them in Paradise or the Fire, nor testify to what does not show.

cards.ask: Which word completes al-Tahawi's statement?
cards.ar: ونذر ____ إلى الله تعالى
cards.source: ونذر سرائرهم إلى الله تعالى
cards.why: سرائرهم: we leave their hidden selves to Allah.

cards.title: The sword
cards.ar: ولا نرى السيف على أحد من أمة محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم إلا من وجب عليه السيف
cards.en: We do not hold with the sword against anyone of Muhammad's ﷺ umma, except one on whom the sword has become due.

cards.ask: Against whom of this umma does al-Tahawi allow the sword?
options: Only one on whom it has become due
Anyone who disagrees with our scholars on any question
cards.source: إلا من وجب عليه السيف
cards.why: Illa man wajaba 'alayhi al-sayf: one on whom it has become due.

cards.ask: Sort: what al-Tahawi says we do, and what we do not do.
items: Pray over a Muslim who died
Place a Muslim in the Fire
Testify to hypocrisy that does not show
Leave people's hidden selves to Allah
source: ونرى الصلاة خلف كل بر وفاجر من أهل القبلة وعلى من مات منهم
ولا ننزل أحدا منهم جنة ولا نارا
ونذر سرائرهم إلى الله تعالى
cards.why: We pray behind and over them and leave their hidden selves to Allah; we place none in the Fire and testify to nothing unseen.

cards.title: No rising against them
cards.ar: ولا نرى الخروج على أئمتنا وولاة أمورنا وإن جاروا ولا ندعوا عليهم ولا ننزع يدا من طاعتهم
cards.en: We do not hold with rising against our leaders and those in charge of our affairs, even if they are unjust. We do not curse them, nor pull our hand away from obeying them.

cards.title: Obeying them
cards.ar: ونرى طاعتهم من طاعة الله عز وجل فريضة ما لم يأمروا بمعصية وندعوا لهم بالصلاح والمعافاة
cards.en: We hold that obeying them is part of obeying Allah, an obligation, as long as they do not command a sin. And we pray for their uprightness and wellbeing.

cards.ask: When is obeying those in charge no longer due, by al-Tahawi's words?
options: When they are unjust to us
cards.source: ما لم يأمروا بمعصية
cards.why: Ma lam ya'muru bi-ma'siya: as long as they do not command a sin.

cards.ask: Which does al-Tahawi say we do towards our leaders?

options.text: Obey them unless they command a sin
Rise against them when they are unjust

source: ونرى طاعتهم من طاعة الله عز وجل فريضة ما لم يأمروا بمعصية وندعوا لهم بالصلاح والمعافاة
ولا نرى الخروج على أئمتنا
cards.why: We obey them, short of sin, and pray for them; we do not rise against them or curse them, even if they are unjust.

cards.title: The Sunna and the Jama'a
cards.ar: ونتبع السنة والجماعة ونجتنب الشذوذ والخلاف والفرقة
cards.en: We follow the Sunna and the Jama'a, and avoid going off alone, discord and division.

cards.ask: Which word completes al-Tahawi's statement?
cards.ar: ونتبع السنة و____
cards.source: ونتبع السنة والجماعة
cards.why: الجماعة: we follow the Sunna and the Jama'a.

cards.title: Whom we love
cards.ar: ونحب أهل العدل والأمانة ونبغض أهل الجور والخيانة
cards.en: We love the people of justice and trust, and dislike the people of injustice and treachery.

cards.ask: Sort: whom al-Tahawi says we love, and whom we dislike.
cards.source: ونحب أهل العدل والأمانة ونبغض أهل الجور والخيانة
cards.why: Justice and trust are loved; injustice and treachery are disliked.

cards.ask: What does al-Tahawi say we avoid?
options: Going off alone, discord and division
Praying for the uprightness of those in charge
cards.source: ونجتنب الشذوذ والخلاف والفرقة
cards.why: Al-shudhudh wal-khilaf wal-furqa: going off alone, discord and division.

cards.title: Allah knows best
cards.ar: ونقول الله أعلم فيما اشتبه علينا علمه
cards.en: Where the knowledge of something is unclear to us, we say: Allah knows best.

cards.ask: What does al-Tahawi say we say where knowledge is unclear to us?
cards.source: ونقول الله أعلم فيما اشتبه علينا علمه
cards.why: Allahu a'lam: Allah knows best.

cards.title: Wiping over khuffs
cards.ar: ونرى المسح على الخفين في السفر والحضر كما جاء في الأثر
cards.en: We hold to wiping over leather socks (khuffs), both travelling and at home, as it has come in the reports.

cards.ask: When does al-Tahawi say we wipe over khuffs?
options: Only in the cold of winter, at home
cards.source: ونرى المسح على الخفين في السفر والحضر
cards.why: Fis-safar wal-hadar: travelling and at home.

cards.title: Hajj and jihad go on
cards.ar: والحج والجهاد ماضيان مع أولي الأمر من المسلمين برهم وفاجرهم إلى قيام الساعة لا يبطلهما شيء ولا ينقضهما
cards.en: Hajj and jihad go on with those in charge among the Muslims, righteous or sinful, until the Hour comes. Nothing cancels or undoes them.

cards.ask: Which word completes al-Tahawi's statement?
cards.ar: والحج والجهاد ____ مع أولي الأمر من المسلمين
cards.source: والحج والجهاد ماضيان مع أولي الأمر من المسلمين
cards.why: ماضيان: they go on until the Hour.

cards.ask: With whom do Hajj and jihad go on, al-Tahawi says?
options: Those in charge, righteous or sinful
Only a just ruler whom all the scholars accept
cards.source: مع أولي الأمر من المسلمين برهم وفاجرهم
cards.why: Barrihim wa fajirihim: with those in charge, righteous or sinful.

cards.ask: Which does al-Tahawi say in these lines?

options.text: Hajj and jihad go on until the Hour
Wiping over khuffs is for home too
Where knowledge is unclear, we say Allah knows best
Hajj stops when the ruler is sinful
Wiping over khuffs is for travellers only

source: ونقول الله أعلم فيما اشتبه علينا علمه
ونرى المسح على الخفين في السفر والحضر
إلى قيام الساعة لا يبطلهما شيء
cards.why: All three are his words; nothing cancels Hajj and jihad, and wiping is for travel and home.

cards.ask: Sort: what al-Tahawi holds, and what he rejects.
items: Hajj goes on with a sinful ruler
Wiping over khuffs is for travel only
Following the Sunna and the Jama'a
source: برهم وفاجرهم إلى قيام الساعة لا يبطلهما شيء
في السفر والحضر
ولا نرى الخروج على أئمتنا وولاة أمورنا وإن جاروا
ونتبع السنة والجماعة
cards.why: Hajj and jihad go on, wiping is at home too, and we follow the Jama'a without rising against unjust rulers.

parts.title: The grave, the rising and His decree

cards.title: The Noble Scribes
cards.ar: ونؤمن بالكرام الكاتبين فإن الله قد جعلهم علينا حافظين
cards.en: We believe in the Noble Scribes (al-Kiram al-Katibin): Allah has made them watchers over us.

cards.title: The Angel of Death
cards.ar: ونؤمن بملك الموت الموكل بقبض أرواح العالمين
cards.en: We believe in the Angel of Death, charged with taking the souls of all beings.

cards.ask: What is the Angel of Death charged with, al-Tahawi says?
options: Taking the souls of all beings
Questioning the dead in the grave
cards.source: ونؤمن بملك الموت الموكل بقبض أرواح العالمين
cards.why: He is charged with qabd al-arwah: taking the souls.

cards.title: The grave and its questions
cards.ar: وبعذاب القبر لمن كان له أهلا وسؤال منكر ونكير في قبره عن ربه ودينه ونبيه
cards.en: And in the punishment of the grave for whoever deserves it, and the questioning by Munkar and Nakir in his grave about his Lord, his religion and his prophet.

cards.ask: What do Munkar and Nakir ask about, al-Tahawi says?
cards.source: وسؤال منكر ونكير في قبره عن ربه ودينه ونبيه
cards.why: 'An rabbihi wa dinihi wa nabiyyihi: his Lord, his religion and his prophet.

cards.title: As the reports bring it
cards.ar: على ما جاءت به الأخبار عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وعن الصحابة رضوان الله عليهم
cards.en: As the reports from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and from the Companions have brought it.

cards.title: A garden or a pit
cards.ar: والقبر روضة من رياض الجنة أو حفرة من حفر النيران
cards.en: The grave is a garden of the gardens of Paradise, or a pit of the pits of the Fire.

cards.ask: Which word completes al-Tahawi's statement?
cards.ar: والقبر ____ من رياض الجنة أو حفرة من حفر النيران
cards.source: والقبر روضة من رياض الجنة أو حفرة من حفر النيران
cards.why: روضة: a garden of the gardens of Paradise.

cards.ask: Who questions the dead in the grave, al-Tahawi says?
cards.source: وسؤال منكر ونكير في قبره
cards.why: Munkar and Nakir question him in his grave.

cards.ask: Which is true, as al-Tahawi says it?
options: The punishment of the grave is for whoever deserves it
The grave is only a place of rest for everyone, good or bad
There is no questioning until the Last Day
cards.source: وبعذاب القبر لمن كان له أهلا
cards.why: We believe in the punishment of the grave for whoever deserves it.

lessons.title: The Rising, Paradise and the Fire

cards.title: The Day of Rising
cards.ar: ونؤمن بالبعث وجزاء الأعمال يوم القيامة والعرض والحساب وقراءة الكتاب والثواب والعقاب والصراط والميزان
cards.en: We believe in the Resurrection and the repaying of deeds on the Day of Rising: the Showing, the Reckoning, the reading of the Book, the reward and punishment, the Bridge (Sirat) and the Scale (Mizan).

cards.ask: Which does al-Tahawi list for the Day of Rising?

options.text: A second life in this world

cards.source: والعرض والحساب وقراءة الكتاب والثواب والعقاب والصراط والميزان
cards.why: Al-'ard, al-hisab, the Book read, reward and punishment, the Sirat and the Mizan.

cards.ask: In al-Tahawi's list, what is the Mizan?
cards.source: والصراط والميزان
cards.why: The Sirat is the Bridge; the Mizan is the Scale.

cards.title: Created, and never ending
cards.ar: والجنة والنار مخلوقتان لا تفنيان أبدا ولا تبيدان
cards.en: Paradise and the Fire are created, and they will never come to an end or pass away.

cards.title: Created with their people
cards.ar: وإن الله تعالى خلق الجنة والنار قبل الخلق وخلق لهما أهلا فمن شاء منهم إلى الجنة فضلا منه ومن شاء منهم إلى النار عدلا منه
cards.en: Allah created Paradise and the Fire before creation, and created people for each. Whom He wills goes to Paradise, out of His grace; whom He wills goes to the Fire, out of His justice.

cards.ask: Which is true, as al-Tahawi says it?
options: Paradise and the Fire are created and never end
Paradise and the Fire will only be created on the Last Day
The Fire will one day come to an end
cards.source: والجنة والنار مخلوقتان لا تفنيان أبدا ولا تبيدان
cards.why: Makhluqatan, la tafniyan: they are created, and never end.

cards.ask: Which word completes al-Tahawi's statement?
cards.ar: والجنة والنار ____ لا تفنيان أبدا ولا تبيدان
cards.source: والجنة والنار مخلوقتان لا تفنيان أبدا ولا تبيدان
cards.why: مخلوقتان: both are created.

cards.title: Each works towards it
cards.ar: وكل يعمل لما قد فرغ له وصائر إلى ما خلق له
cards.en: Each one works towards what has been settled for him, and is headed to what he was created for.

cards.title: Good and evil decreed
cards.ar: والخير والشر مقدران على العباد
cards.en: Good and evil are both decreed for servants.

cards.ask: What does al-Tahawi say of good and evil?
options: Only the good is decreed; evil comes from the servant alone
cards.source: والخير والشر مقدران على العباد
cards.why: Muqaddarani: both are decreed.

cards.title: Capacity with the deed
cards.ar: والاستطاعة التي يجب بها الفعل من نحو التوفيق الذي لا يجوز أن يوصف المخلوق به فهي مع الفعل
cards.en: Capacity (istita'a) is of two kinds. The capacity by which a deed actually happens, of the kind of divine enabling (tawfiq), which no creature can be described as having, comes with the deed.

cards.title: Capacity before the deed
cards.ar: وأما الاستطاعة من جهة الصحة والوسع والتمكن وسلامة الآلات فهي قبل الفعل وبها يتعلق الخطاب
cards.en: The capacity of health, means, ability and sound limbs comes before the deed, and it is what Allah's command (khitab) is tied to.

cards.ask: How many kinds of capacity does al-Tahawi describe?
source: والاستطاعة التي يجب بها الفعل
وأما الاستطاعة من جهة الصحة
cards.why: One that comes with the deed, and one that comes before it.

cards.ask: Sort: which capacity does al-Tahawi say comes with the deed, and which before it?
source: من نحو التوفيق الذي لا يجوز أن يوصف المخلوق به فهي مع الفعل
من جهة الصحة والوسع والتمكن وسلامة الآلات فهي قبل الفعل
cards.why: The tawfiq kind comes with the deed; health, means, ability and sound limbs come before it.

cards.title: No soul beyond its capacity
cards.ar: وهو كما قال تعالى لا يكلف الله نفسا إلا وسعها
cards.en: It is as Allah says: "Allah does not burden a soul beyond its capacity" (2:286).

cards.title: Created and acquired
cards.ar: وأفعال العباد خلق الله وكسب من العباد
cards.en: The acts of servants are Allah's creation, and the servants' acquiring (kasb).

cards.ask: Which word completes al-Tahawi's statement?
cards.ar: وأفعال العباد خلق الله و____ من العباد
cards.source: وأفعال العباد خلق الله وكسب من العباد
cards.why: كسب: the acts are Allah's creation and the servants' acquiring.

cards.title: Only what they can bear
cards.ar: ولم يكلفهم الله تعالى إلا ما يطيقون ولا يطيقون إلا ما كلفهم
cards.en: Allah has charged them only with what they can bear, and they can bear only what He has charged them with.

cards.title: No power except by Allah
cards.ar: وهو تفسير لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله
cards.en: That is the meaning of "There is no power and no strength except by Allah" (la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah).

cards.ask: With what has Allah charged servants, al-Tahawi says?
options: More than they can bear, to test them
Nothing at all: they are left free
cards.source: ولم يكلفهم الله تعالى إلا ما يطيقون
cards.why: Illa ma yutiqun: only what they can bear.

cards.title: No turning from sin but by His help
cards.ar: نقول لا حيلة لأحد ولا حركة لأحد ولا تحول لأحد عن معصية الله إلا بمعونة الله
cards.en: We say: no one has any means, any movement or any turning away from disobeying Allah, except by Allah's help.

cards.title: No strength for obedience but by His enabling
cards.ar: ولا قوة لأحد على إقامة طاعة الله والثبات عليها إلا بتوفيق الله
cards.en: And no one has strength to do what Allah commands and stay firm on it, except by Allah's enabling (tawfiq).

cards.ask: Which does al-Tahawi say here?

options.text: Allah charges people only with what they can bear
No one turns from sin except by Allah's help
No one stays firm in obedience except by Allah's enabling
Allah charges people with more than they can bear
People can obey by their own strength alone

source: ولم يكلفهم الله تعالى إلا ما يطيقون
ولا تحول لأحد عن معصية الله إلا بمعونة الله
والثبات عليها إلا بتوفيق الله
cards.why: This is the meaning of la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.

lessons.title: His will, du'a and His pleasure

cards.title: His will overcomes all
cards.ar: وكل شيء يجري بمشيئة الله تعالى وعلمه وقضائه وقدره غلبت مشيئة المشيئات كلها وغلب قضاؤه الحيل كلها
cards.en: Everything runs by Allah's will, knowledge, decree and measure. His will overcomes all wills, and His decree overcomes all schemes.

cards.title: Never unjust
cards.ar: يفعل ما يشاء وهو غير ظالم أبدا تقدس عن كل سوء وحين وتنزه عن كل عيب وشين
cards.en: He does what He wills, and He is never unjust. He is holy above every evil and ruin, and far above every fault and flaw.

cards.ask: Which is true, as al-Tahawi says it?
options: Allah does what He wills and is never unjust
Allah's will can be overcome by a strong scheme
Allah's will is only over the heavens
cards.source: يفعل ما يشاء وهو غير ظالم أبدا
cards.why: He does what He wills, and is never unjust; His decree overcomes every scheme.

cards.title: The living help the dead
cards.ar: وفي دعاء الأحياء وصدقاتهم منفعة للأموات
cards.en: The du'a of the living and their charity bring benefit to the dead.

cards.title: He answers
cards.ar: والله تعالى يستجيب الدعوات ويقضي الحاجات
cards.en: Allah answers prayers and fulfils needs.

cards.ask: What does al-Tahawi say benefits the dead?
cards.source: وفي دعاء الأحياء وصدقاتهم منفعة للأموات
cards.why: Du'a and sadaqa from the living benefit the dead.

cards.ask: Which word completes al-Tahawi's statement?
cards.ar: وفي دعاء الأحياء وصدقاتهم ____ للأموات
cards.source: وفي دعاء الأحياء وصدقاتهم منفعة للأموات
cards.why: منفعة: they bring benefit to the dead.

cards.title: He owns everything
cards.ar: ويملك كل شيء ولا يملكه شيء ولا غنى عن الله تعالى طرفة عين
cards.en: He owns everything, and nothing owns Him. No one can do without Allah for the blink of an eye.

cards.title: Whoever thinks himself free of Him
cards.ar: ومن استغنى عن الله طرفة عين فقد كفر وصار من أهل الحين
cards.en: Whoever thinks himself free of need of Allah for the blink of an eye has disbelieved and become one of the ruined.

cards.ask: For how long can anyone do without Allah, al-Tahawi says?
options: Not for the blink of an eye
For as long as he is healthy
cards.source: ولا غنى عن الله تعالى طرفة عين
cards.why: La ghina 'an Allah tarfata 'ayn: not for the blink of an eye.

cards.title: Angered and pleased
cards.ar: والله يغضب ويرضى لا كأحد من الورى
cards.en: Allah is angered and is pleased, not like anyone of creation.

cards.ask: How does al-Tahawi say Allah is angered and pleased?
options: He is never angered or pleased
cards.source: والله يغضب ويرضى لا كأحد من الورى
cards.why: Yaghdabu wa yarda, la ka-ahadin min al-wara: not like anyone of creation.

cards.ask: Sort: what al-Tahawi affirms, and what he rejects.
items: Du'a of the living benefits the dead
Allah is pleased as a creature is
source: وهو غير ظالم أبدا
وفي دعاء الأحياء وصدقاتهم منفعة للأموات
ولا يملكه شيء
والله تعالى يستجيب الدعوات
لا كأحد من الورى
cards.why: He is never unjust and nothing owns Him; du'a helps the dead, He answers prayers, and His pleasure is not like a creature's.

parts.title: The Companions, the awliya and the Jama'a

cards.title: We love them all
cards.ar: ونحب أصحاب رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ولا نفرط في حب أحد منهم ولا نتبرأ من أحد منهم
cards.en: We love the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. We do not go to excess in loving any one of them, nor disown any one of them.

cards.title: Only good
cards.ar: ونبغض من يبغضهم وبغير الخير يذكرهم ولا نذكرهم إلا بخير
cards.en: We dislike whoever dislikes them or speaks of them other than well, and we speak of them only well.

cards.ask: Which does al-Tahawi say we do towards the Companions?

options.text: Go to excess in loving one of them

source: ونحب أصحاب رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ولا نفرط في حب أحد منهم ولا نتبرأ من أحد منهم
ولا نذكرهم إلا بخير
cards.why: We love them and speak only well of them, without excess for one or disowning another.

cards.title: Love of them is religion
cards.ar: وحبهم دين وإيمان وإحسان وبغضهم كفر ونفاق وطغيان
cards.en: Loving them is religion, iman and ihsan; hating them is disbelief, hypocrisy and transgression.

cards.ask: Sort: what al-Tahawi says loving them is, and what hating them is.
cards.source: وحبهم دين وإيمان وإحسان وبغضهم كفر ونفاق وطغيان
cards.why: Love: din, iman, ihsan. Hate: kufr, nifaq, tughyan.

cards.ask: Which word completes al-Tahawi's statement?
cards.ar: وحبهم دين وإيمان و____
cards.source: وحبهم دين وإيمان وإحسان
cards.why: إحسان: loving them is religion, iman and ihsan.

cards.ask: Which is true, as al-Tahawi says it?
