options: We love all the Companions and disown none of them
We love some Companions and disown others
We go to excess in loving one Companion above all the rest
cards.source: ولا نفرط في حب أحد منهم ولا نتبرأ من أحد منهم
cards.why: We love them without excess for any, and disown none.

cards.ask: How do we speak of the Companions, al-Tahawi says?
cards.source: ولا نذكرهم إلا بخير
cards.why: La nadhkuruhum illa bi-khayr: only well.

cards.title: Abu Bakr first
cards.ar: ونثبت الخلافة بعد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أولا لأبي بكر الصديق رضي الله عنه تفضيلا له وتقديما على جميع الأمة
cards.en: We affirm the caliphate after the Messenger of Allah ﷺ first for Abu Bakr al-Siddiq, preferring him and putting him before the whole umma.

cards.title: Then Umar, Uthman, Ali
cards.ar: ثم لعمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه ثم لعثمان رضي الله عنه ثم لعلي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه وهم الخلفاء الراشدون والأئمة المهتدون
cards.en: Then for Umar ibn al-Khattab, then Uthman, then Ali ibn Abi Talib. They are the Rightly-Guided Caliphs (al-khulafa' al-rashidun) and the guided imams.

cards.ask: Put the caliphs in al-Tahawi's order.
source: أولا لأبي بكر الصديق
ثم لعمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه ثم لعثمان رضي الله عنه ثم لعلي بن أبي طالب
cards.why: Abu Bakr first, then Umar, then Uthman, then Ali.

cards.ask: Who does al-Tahawi say was caliph first, after the Messenger ﷺ?
cards.source: ونثبت الخلافة بعد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أولا لأبي بكر الصديق
cards.why: Awwalan li-Abi Bakr: first for Abu Bakr al-Siddiq.

cards.title: The Ten given glad news
cards.ar: وأن العشرة الذين سماهم رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وبشرهم بالجنة نشهد لهم بالجنة على ما شهد لهم رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وقوله الحق
cards.en: The Ten whom the Messenger of Allah ﷺ named and gave the glad news of Paradise: we testify that they are in Paradise, as he testified for them, and his word is truth.

cards.title: Their names
cards.ar: وهم أبو بكر وعمر وعثمان علي وطلحة والزبير وسعد وسعيد وعبد الرحمن بن عوف وأبو عبيدة الجراح وهو أمين هذه الأمة
cards.en: They are Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman, Ali, Talha, al-Zubayr, Sa'd, Sa'id, Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf, and Abu Ubayda ibn al-Jarrah, the trustee of this umma.

cards.ask: Which of these are among the Ten al-Tahawi names?
cards.source: وطلحة والزبير وسعد وسعيد وعبد الرحمن بن عوف وأبو عبيدة الجراح
cards.why: All four are in his list of the Ten; Bilal and Khalid are not in it.

cards.ask: Whom does al-Tahawi call the trustee (amin) of this umma?
cards.source: وأبو عبيدة الجراح وهو أمين هذه الأمة
cards.why: Abu Ubayda ibn al-Jarrah: amin hadhihi al-umma.

cards.title: Free of hypocrisy
cards.ar: ومن أحسن القول في أصحاب رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وأزواجه الطاهرات من كل دنس وذرياته المقدسين من كل رجس فقد برئ من النفاق
cards.en: Whoever speaks well of the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, of his wives, pure of every stain, and of his offspring, sanctified from every filth, is free of hypocrisy.

cards.ask: Who is free of hypocrisy, al-Tahawi says?
options: Whoever speaks well of the Companions, wives and offspring
Whoever speaks well of the Prophet's offspring alone
Whoever praises some Companions and finds fault with the rest
cards.source: ومن أحسن القول في أصحاب رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وأزواجه
cards.why: He speaks well of all three: the Companions, the wives and the offspring.

cards.title: The scholars of the salaf
cards.ar: وعلماء السلف من السابقين ومن بعدهم من التابعين أهل الخير والأثر وأهل الفقه والنظر لا يذكرون إلا بالجميل
cards.en: The scholars of the early generations (salaf), the first ones and the Successors (tabi'in) after them, people of good and of reports, people of fiqh and reasoning, are spoken of only with what is beautiful.

cards.title: Speaking ill of them
cards.ar: ومن ذكرهم بسوء فهو على غير السبيل
cards.en: Whoever speaks ill of them is off the path.

cards.ask: How are the scholars of the salaf to be spoken of, al-Tahawi says?
options: With their faults put before their merits
cards.source: لا يذكرون إلا بالجميل
cards.why: Illa bil-jamil: only with what is beautiful.

cards.title: No wali above a prophet
cards.ar: ولا نفضل أحدا من الأولياء على أحد من الأنبياء عليهم السلام
cards.en: We do not prefer any of the awliya (friends of Allah) over any of the prophets.

cards.title: One prophet is better
cards.ar: ونقول نبي واحد أفضل من جميع الأولياء
cards.en: We say: a single prophet is better than all the awliya together.

cards.ask: Which word completes al-Tahawi's statement?
cards.ar: ونقول نبي واحد أفضل من جميع ____
cards.source: ونقول نبي واحد أفضل من جميع الأولياء
cards.why: الأولياء: one prophet is better than all the awliya.

cards.title: Their wonders
cards.ar: ونؤمن بما جاء من كراماتهم وصح عن الثقات من رواياتهم
cards.en: We believe in what has come of their wonders (karamat), soundly reported by trustworthy narrators.

cards.ask: Which is true, as al-Tahawi says it?
options: One prophet is better than all the awliya
A great wali can be better than a prophet
The awliya have no wonders at all
cards.source: ونقول نبي واحد أفضل من جميع الأولياء
cards.why: No wali is preferred over any prophet; one prophet is better than all of them.

cards.ask: Which does al-Tahawi affirm?

options.text: The wonders (karamat) of the awliya, soundly reported
Speaking well of the scholars of the salaf
Preferring a wali over a prophet

source: ونؤمن بما جاء من كراماتهم وصح عن الثقات من رواياتهم
لا يذكرون إلا بالجميل
cards.why: He affirms soundly reported karamat and speaking well of the salaf; whoever speaks ill of them is off the path.

cards.title: The Dajjal and 'Isa
cards.ar: ونؤمن بأشراط الساعة من خروج الدجال ونزول عيسى ابن مريم عليه السلام من السماء
cards.en: We believe in the signs of the Hour: the coming out of the Dajjal, and the descent of 'Isa son of Maryam from the heaven.

cards.title: The sun and the Beast
cards.ar: ونؤمن بطلوع الشمس من مغربها وخروج دابة الأرض من موضعها
cards.en: And we believe in the sun rising from the west, and the Beast of the Earth coming out from its place.

cards.ask: Which signs of the Hour does al-Tahawi name?

options.text: The coming out of the Dajjal
The descent of 'Isa from the heaven
The sun rising from the west
The Beast of the Earth coming out

source: من خروج الدجال ونزول عيسى ابن مريم عليه السلام من السماء
ونؤمن بطلوع الشمس من مغربها وخروج دابة الأرض من موضعها
cards.why: His four: the Dajjal, 'Isa's descent, the sun from the west, and the Beast of the Earth.

cards.ask: From where does al-Tahawi say 'Isa son of Maryam descends?
cards.source: ونزول عيسى ابن مريم عليه السلام من السماء
cards.why: Min al-sama': from the heaven.

cards.ask: Which word completes al-Tahawi's statement?
cards.ar: ونؤمن بطلوع الشمس من ____
cards.source: ونؤمن بطلوع الشمس من مغربها
cards.why: مغربها: the sun rising from where it sets, the west.

cards.title: No soothsayer
cards.ar: ولا نصدق كاهنا ولا عرافا ولا من يدعي شيئا يخالف الكتاب والسنة وإجماع الأمة
cards.en: We do not believe a soothsayer (kahin) or a fortune-teller ('arraf), nor anyone who claims something against the Book, the Sunna and the consensus (ijma') of the umma.

cards.ask: Whom does al-Tahawi say we do not believe?

options.text: Anyone who claims what goes against the Book and Sunna
A sound report from trustworthy narrators

cards.source: ولا نصدق كاهنا ولا عرافا ولا من يدعي شيئا يخالف الكتاب والسنة وإجماع الأمة
cards.why: Kahin, 'arraf, and anyone claiming against the Book, Sunna and ijma'.

cards.ask: Which three does al-Tahawi say a claim must not go against?
options: The Book, the Sunna and the consensus of the umma
The ruler's word, the people's custom and the philosophers' reasoning
cards.source: يخالف الكتاب والسنة وإجماع الأمة
cards.why: Al-kitab wal-sunna wa ijma' al-umma.

cards.ask: Sort: what al-Tahawi believes, and what he does not believe.
source: من خروج الدجال ونزول عيسى ابن مريم
وخروج دابة الأرض من موضعها
ولا نصدق كاهنا ولا عرافا
cards.why: The signs of the Hour are believed; soothsayers and fortune-tellers are not.

cards.title: The Jama'a is truth
cards.ar: ونرى الجماعة حقا وصوابا والفرقة زيغا وعذابا
cards.en: We hold the Jama'a (keeping together) to be truth and right, and division to be deviation and torment.

cards.ask: Sort: what al-Tahawi says the Jama'a is, and what division is.
cards.source: ونرى الجماعة حقا وصوابا والفرقة زيغا وعذابا
cards.why: The Jama'a is haqq and sawab; division is zaygh and 'adhab.

cards.title: One religion
cards.ar: ودين الله في الأرض والسماء واحد وهو دين الإسلام
cards.en: Allah's religion, in the earth and in the heaven, is one: it is the religion of Islam.

cards.title: As Allah says
cards.ar: قال الله تعالى إن الدين عند الله الإسلام وقال تعالى ورضيت لكم الإسلام دينا
cards.en: Allah says: "The religion with Allah is Islam" (3:19), and: "I am pleased with Islam as your religion" (5:3).

cards.ask: How many religions of Allah are there, in the earth and the heaven, by al-Tahawi's words?
options: Two: one for the earth, one for the heaven
cards.source: ودين الله في الأرض والسماء واحد وهو دين الإسلام
cards.why: Wahid: one, the religion of Islam.

cards.title: Between the extremes
cards.ar: وهو بين الغلو والتقصير وبين التشبيه والتعطيل وبين الجبر والقدر وبين الأمن والإياس
cards.en: It lies between excess and falling short, between likening (tashbih) and stripping away (ta'til), between compulsion (jabr) and denying the decree (qadar), and between feeling safe and despair.

cards.ask: Islam lies between which pairs, al-Tahawi says?
cards.source: وهو بين الغلو والتقصير وبين التشبيه والتعطيل وبين الجبر والقدر وبين الأمن والإياس
cards.why: His four pairs; the religion is the middle of each.

cards.ask: Which word completes al-Tahawi's statement?
cards.ar: وبين الجبر و____
cards.source: وبين الجبر والقدر
cards.why: القدر: between jabr and qadar.

cards.ask: Which is true, as al-Tahawi says it?
options: Division is a mercy for the umma
The Jama'a is one opinion among many
cards.source: والفرقة زيغا وعذابا
cards.why: Al-furqa zaygh wa 'adhab: division is deviation and torment.

cards.title: Our religion and creed
cards.ar: فهذا ديننا واعتقادنا ظاهرا وباطنا
cards.en: This is our religion and our creed, outwardly and inwardly.

cards.title: Clear of who opposes it
cards.ar: ونحن براء إلى الله من كل من خالف الذي ذكرناه وبيناه
cards.en: We are clear before Allah of everyone who goes against what we have stated and made clear.

cards.ask: How does al-Tahawi say this creed is held?
cards.source: فهذا ديننا واعتقادنا ظاهرا وباطنا
cards.why: Zahiran wa batinan: outwardly and inwardly.

cards.title: Keep us firm
cards.ar: ونسأل الله تعالى أن يثبتنا على الإيمان ويختم لنا به
cards.en: We ask Allah to keep us firm on iman and seal our lives with it.

cards.title: Protect us
cards.ar: ويعصمنا من الأهواء المختلفة والآراء المتفرقة والمذاهب الردية
cards.en: And to protect us from the many desires, the scattered opinions and the bad ways.

cards.ask: Which word completes al-Tahawi's statement?
cards.ar: ونسأل الله تعالى أن يثبتنا على الإيمان و____ لنا به
cards.source: ونسأل الله تعالى أن يثبتنا على الإيمان ويختم لنا به
cards.why: يختم: that He seal our lives with iman.

cards.title: The groups he names
cards.ar: مثل المشبهة والمعتزلة والجهمية والجبرية والقدرية وغيرهم من الذين خالفوا السنة والجماعة
cards.en: Such as the Mushabbiha, the Mu'tazila, the Jahmiyya, the Jabriyya and the Qadariyya, and others who went against the Sunna and the Jama'a.

cards.ask: Which groups does al-Tahawi name at the close?
cards.source: مثل المشبهة والمعتزلة والجهمية والجبرية والقدرية
cards.why: He names the Mushabbiha, Mu'tazila, Jahmiyya, Jabriyya and Qadariyya; he wrote on the way of Abu Hanifa, for Ahl al-Sunna.

cards.title: His last words
cards.ar: وحالفوا الضلالة ونحن منهم براء وهم عندنا ضلال وأردياء وبالله العصمة والتوفيق
cards.en: ...and who allied themselves with misguidance. We are clear of them; to us they are astray and ruined. And with Allah is protection and success.

cards.ask: What does al-Tahawi ask Allah for at the close?
options: To keep us firm on iman and seal our lives with it
To give us wealth and long life
To let us know the secret of the decree before we die
cards.source: ونسأل الله تعالى أن يثبتنا على الإيمان ويختم لنا به
cards.why: Firmness on iman and a sealing with it, and protection from bad ways.

cards.ask: Put the close in al-Tahawi's order.
steps: This is our religion and creed
We are clear of whoever goes against it
We ask Allah to keep us firm on iman
We ask Him to protect us from bad ways
cards.source: فهذا ديننا واعتقادنا ظاهرا وباطنا ونحن براء إلى الله من كل من خالف الذي ذكرناه وبيناه ونسأل الله تعالى أن يثبتنا على الإيمان ويختم لنا به ويعصمنا من الأهواء المختلفة
cards.why: Our creed; clear of its opponents; a prayer for firmness; a prayer for protection.
